objective: An exact census, frozen before it runs: the four symmetric three-place knot laws on every world of knots alone in the frozen ranges (surface worlds of degree 3 to 7, Altshuler's tori to 48 distinctions, d-regular triple systems without the surface condition at small sizes), reporting for each law and world whether it is allowed, native, frozen, tied and read faithfully, and bond distance on small flat worlds; predictions P1 to P5 and their failure lines as registered.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-11 (frozen, exact): the census ran on 1,602 worlds in 887 s. P1 holds (NAE faithful on tetrahedron, octahedron, icosahedron; no state on the hemi-icosahedron); P4 holds (NAE allows all 11 Klein bottles and 294 of 295 tori); P2 fails narrowly (227 of 229 flat worlds without a non-facial triangle read faithfully; the exceptions are two edge-width-4 tori); P5 fails at distance 3 (bond distance 2 and 3 at graph distances 1 and 2 on all 38 faithful tori, 3 or 4 at distance 3); P3 fails as registered (no NAE-faithful non-surface world found at d >= 4 in a biased sample). Lemmas D1 to D6 reproduced on every world read; independent paths agree; refereed.
title: What a uniform knot law reads of a world of knots alone
